_comment: COUPLING tier-2, FSI added mass. The `fsi` pitfall group tells an agent that a partitioned FSI with an incompressible fluid diverges once the fluid it has to push is not light against the structure, that the residual GROWS rather than stalls, and that relaxation moves that boundary without removing it. This fixture is where that came from. One backward-Euler step from rest (DT=0.01), everything held fixed except the structure density, coupled through the public `couple` tool with a 32x8 fluid mesh. The full sweep that produced the entry, over rho_s = 1000/100/10/1/0.1 against rho_f*L = 1 and rho_s*h the structural mass per unit area: UNRELAXED (constant, theta=1) rho_s=1000 (mass ratio 50) converges in 17 iterations to 8.50e-08; rho_s=100 (ratio 5) DIVERGES with the residual going 6.18e-01 -> 9.76e-01 -> 1.96e+00 and sitting at 3.72e-01 after 25; rho_s=10, 1 and 0.1 diverge hard enough that the ALE mesh inverts and the fluid participant exits non-zero at iterations 11, 9 and 9. With AITKEN (theta0=0.5) rho_s=1000 converges in 19; rho_s=100 is RESCUED — the residual falls monotonically 6.18e-01 -> 5.73e-01 -> 5.37e-01 ... -> 2.36e-04 at 25 iterations, a factor 1576 below what constant relaxation left at the same density — and rho_s=10, 1, 0.1 still diverge (6.18e-01 -> 1.47e+00 -> 1.51e+00 at rho_s=10). So the boundary moves from between ratio 50 and 5 to between ratio 5 and 0.5, and does not go away. The fixture re-runs four of those ten points and asserts the SHAPE, never the threshold: the density at which each transition happens is a property of this geometry and asserting it would turn a measurement into a number to hit. It also pins the Signal the entry promises — that the verdict alone does not separate divergence from slow convergence (both are converged=false) and the residual history does.

_mutation.note: Make every structure 100x heavier than the fixture asked for. The light case is then no longer light, its iteration is stable, and light_unrelaxed_diverges dies — which is the assertion carrying the whole claim. Nothing else in the fixture notices: the heavy case still converges, the histories still fall, and the run reads as a clean sweep of a coupling that has no instability. That is exactly the shape of the failure this fixture exists to prevent, an added-mass warning served to agents on the strength of a sweep that never crossed the boundary. VERIFIED 2026-08-07: killed, with light_unrelaxed_converged=False and light_unrelaxed_residual_grew=True both MISSING from the mutant's output — the light case became stable, exactly as predicted.

Leave the structure transient but make the FLUID steady, so its interface is a stationary wall and the u = d/dt kinematic term disappears. That term is the only path by which the structure's acceleration reaches the fluid, so with it gone there is no added mass at any density and the light case converges. It kills light_unrelaxed_diverges, and it is the mutation that demonstrates WHERE the added mass comes from rather than merely that it is there. VERIFIED 2026-08-07: killed, with the same two keys missing — with the kinematic term gone there is no added mass at any density.

Make the STRUCTURE static while the fluid stays transient: with DT=0 its inertia term is skipped entirely and it responds statically to whatever the fluid pushes, so the added mass dominates at every density in the sweep and the HEAVY control diverges, killing heavy_unrelaxed_converges. This is the opposite-direction control, and it is needed: without it, a fixture in which every single run diverged would still report the instability it was looking for. VERIFIED 2026-08-07: killed.
